--- Message 1 of 4 ---

Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Synapse Labs POC Environment & Close Timeline

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our SLT, I pulled together a first-pass mutual action plan for the 4-week POC so both teams have a clear close timeline and the technical steps for environment readiness. The primary items for Synapse to unblock are:

- Org setup (tenant & service accounts)
- API key provisioning (ephemeral keys for POC)
- IP allowlist (public egress IPs for NetOps)
- Optional VPC peering (if you want private traffic)

Attached is the draft MAP with proposed due dates and owners. Proposed milestones (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): mutual sign-off on MAP and NetOps contact
2) Week 1: org seed + API key generation and test call
3) Week 2: IP allowlist configured; basic inference run
4) Week 3: (optional) VPC peering window and acceptance tests
5) Week 4: final acceptance & handoff to ops; contract close checklist

Could you confirm: 1) the best NetOps contact for IP allowlist + peering coordination, 2) preferred peering window (weekday/hour), and 3) whether we should proceed with a short-term ephemeral key for POC or a service account key?

I cc'ed Vanessa from our CS team for timeline alignment.

Attachments: synapse-map-draft.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear plan and the draft. Quick answers:

- API keys: ephemeral keys are fine for the POC; we can create a scoped token and revoke after acceptance.

NetOps (Marta), can you confirm the allowlist method you prefer (column of IPs vs. managed peering) and any ACL template you need? We currently have a ticket open for the POC: SYN-POC-1129.

I reviewed the MAP and the dates look achievable. I can commit our infra engineer for the peering window if needed.

Hi Alex / Marta —

Thanks — marking this thread with the technical confirmations and our proposed dates. Summary and agreed actions below:

1) API key provisioning (owner: Redwood infra / Markus)
   - We will create a scoped ephemeral token for Synapse with a 7-day TTL for initial testing.
   - Sample curl included in Doc (one-line) and a short TTL policy.
   - Action: markus.klein to provision token and post one-time curl by Tue 2028-06-20.

2) IP allowlist (owner: Synapse NetOps)
   - Redwood will provide three public egress IPs to add to Synapse ACL: 34.208.17.45, 34.208.17.46, 34.208.17.47.
   - Please confirm these are acceptable and whether you prefer CIDR vs single-host entries.
   - Action: Marta to confirm by Mon 2028-06-19 (ticket SYN-POC-1129).

3) VPC peering (optional; owner: both teams)
   - Proposed peering window accepted: Tue/Thu 02:00–04:00 PT.
   - For initial handoff we'll support static route config; if you need BGP we can escalate.
   - Action: NetOps to fill peering-config-template and return; Redwood to run a preflight test during the agreed window (first window: Thu 2028-06-22 02:00–03:00 PT).

4) Final acceptance & close cadence
   - If Week 1 & Week 2 milestones pass, we aim to run acceptance tests in Week 3 and complete the MAP by 2028-07-06.

Attachments: MAP-final-checklist.pdf (final checklist)

If that works I will update the shared MAP (Drive link below) and Sofia will follow up with contract/close checklist.
